Name: RNase_T1_Phosphatase
RegExDescription: RNase T1 cuts after G. Then a phosphatase is added to remove the 3' terminal phosphate

Name: cusativin
RegExDescription: Cusativin cuts after a row of Cs.

Name: RNase_U2
RegExDescription: RNase U2 cuts after A or G.

Name: RNase_A
RegExDescription: RNase A cuts after C or U.

Name: RNase_H
RegExDescription: RNase H can cut anywhere (in an RNA-DNA duplex).

Name: RNase_4
RegExDescription: RNase 4 cuts after U (or modified U) only if followed by A or G. NB: 3' ends are Heterogenous, run in parallel with RNase_4p and RNase_4c to get 3'p and 3'c as well

Name: RNase_4p
RegExDescription: RNase 4 cuts after U (or modified U) only if followed by A or G. NB: 3' ends are Heterogenous, run in parallel with RNase_4 and RNase_4c to get 3'OH and 3'c as well

Name: RNase_4c
RegExDescription: RNase 4 cuts after U (or modified U) only if followed by A or G. NB: 3' ends are Heterogenous, run in parallel with RNase_4 and RNase_4p to get 3'OH and 3'p as well

Name: mazF
RegExDescription: mazF cuts before ACA but does not cut if the first A is an m6A OR the C is an m5C. NB cleaving behaviour relative to other methylation is not considered

Name: colicin_E5
RegExDescription: colicin E5 cuts after G (or Q) followed by U.

Name: unspecific cleavage
RegExDescription: Unspecific cleavage cuts at every site.
